journey.name: Lift: change a program day and keep it
journey.description: Follow Goblet squat and row, change day 1 in the session (a heavier bell, a set changed after logging, the rows skipped), finish, and keep the change in a copy of the program, which is then followed from day 2 with the bell planned. Then day 2 done in full, said to have felt all out: its steps up wait, off, until one is turned on. Last, the ABC either way: 20 minutes beside BJJ's ABC on the minute taken as many as you can for today, the program left on the minute. And the bell waits: with only 16 and 20 kg owned, a new program's 5 × 10 two-hand swings at 16 kg, done in full, step to rest shorter, not to the 20. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Follow a program"
Tap "Goblet squat and row", then "Follow this program"
Tap "Start day 1"
Verify that the session shows "Up next · 1 of 9 sets", a figure doing the goblet squat over "Goblet squat", "16 kg × 10", "Change", "Skip" and "Today's plan", with "Log set" at the bottom
Tap "Change" on the Up next card
Verify that a sheet shows an exercise card "Goblet squat" with "Change", "Bell" chips with "Last time" selected, "How it runs", "Sets" at "3" and "Reps" at "10"
Tap "24", then "Done"
Verify that Up next reads "24 kg × 10"
Tap "Log set"
Verify that "Up next · 2 of 9 sets" is shown and the session lists "Goblet squat" with a set "24 kg × 10", "Moved" at "240 kg"
Tap the set "24 kg × 10"
Verify that a sheet shows "Goblet squat" without "Change", no "An EMOM", and "Save set"
Tap "+" beside the reps once, then "Save set"
Verify that the set reads "24 kg × 11" and "Moved" reads "264 kg"
Tap "Today's plan"
Verify that the sheet lists "Goblet squat" "3 × 10 (10–15) · 24 kg" "1 of 3 done" with "Changed", and "Row" "3 × 10 a side" "0 of 6 done"
Tap "Row"
Tap "Skip this block"
Verify that Up next reads "Goblet squat" and "Up next · 2 of 3 sets"
Tap "Finish"
Scroll down the summary
Verify that "Keep today's changes?" shows "Goblet squat" with "3 × 10 (10–15) → 3 × 10 (10–15) · 24 kg", "This day" and "Every day", and "Save as Goblet squat and row (yours)"
Tap "Every day", then "Save as Goblet squat and row (yours)"
Verify that "Saved as Goblet squat and row (yours). You follow it from day 2." is shown
Tap "Done"
Verify that Lift shows "Day 2 of 8 · week 1", "Goblet squat and row (yours)", "Goblet squat" "3 × 10 (10–15)" with "24 kg", and "Start day 2"
Tap "Start day 2", then "Log set" until "Up next" is gone (9 sets), then "Finish"
Verify that "Next time" lists "Goblet squat" and "Row" a rep more, both switched on, and "Save to Goblet squat and row (yours)" is offered
Under "How was it?" tap "All out"
Verify that "It felt very hard: these wait until you turn them on." shows under "Next time", both switches are off, and no Save is offered
Tap "Done"
Verify that no "Keep today's changes?" question is asked, and Lift shows "Day 3 of 8 · week 2" with "Goblet squat" still "3 × 10 (10–15)"
Tap "All programs", find "20 minutes beside BJJ", tap it, then "Follow this program" and "Switch"
Tap "Start day 1" and verify that the session's foot offers "Start EMOM"
Tap "Today's plan", then "Armor Building Complex"
Verify that the sheet offers "As many as you can" under the block's minutes, at 15; tap it
Verify that "Time cap" is now picked, "Minutes" still reads 15, and the button reads "On the minute"; tap "Done"
Verify that Up next reads "Up next · 15 min cap" and the foot offers "Start the clock"
Press Back, then "Leave": nothing is logged, so the session isn't kept
Verify that Lift shows "Day 1 of 12 · week 1", "Armor Building Complex" "1 every minute for 15 minutes": the program is still on the minute
Open "Your equipment" and leave only the 16 kg and 20 kg bells owned

Tap "All programs", then "New program"; tap "Add block", keep "Two-hand swing" 5 × 10, pick the "16" bell, tap "Done"; name it "Swings" and save it, then tap "Swings" and "Follow this program": no "Switch" is asked, since the program it replaces is still on day 1
Tap "Start day 1", then "Log set" five times (skipping each rest), then "Finish"
Verify that "Next time" lists "Two-hand swing" "5 × 10 · 16 kg → 5 × 10 · 75 s rest · 16 kg", switched on, with "Denser first: the same work in less rest" under it
